expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Two nights at a five star on the Nha Trang seafront, and the bay as a day trip rather than a cruise. It suits people who would rather sleep on land.
expert.tip: Take the Halong day trip early. The boats leave the pier before the tour buses arrive and the bay is still.

summary: Seven days with a beach in the middle: two nights in Hanoi with a full day on Halong Bay and the hidden Ba Ham lakes, two at a five star hotel on the Nha Trang seafront with an island boat day, then two back in the capital with a day in Ninh Binh.
included: Included: 6 nights with breakfast and dinner daily, two of them at a five star seafront hotel; return domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a Halong Bay day cruise with the Ba Ham lakes; a Nha Trang island tour; a Ninh Binh day tour; a cycle ride to Bich Dong.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the boat days; travel insurance; personal expenses.
